data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis, MED): the emitted flag pair must carry the ordering edge at emission time — the flag-cleanup task is emitted with depends_on referencing the flag-cutover task's temp_id (cleanup only safe AFTER cutover). Two-pass ordering (982a) CONSUMES depends_on edges, it does not create them; without the edge cleanup could run before cutover. Mirror the sweep pair's manual-verification depends_on automated-sweep. Document the ordering invariant in feature-flags-marker.md. Verify: grep -qiE 'flag-cleanup.{0,120}depends_on|depends_on.{0,120}flag-cutover|cleanup.{0,80}after.{0,80}cutover' plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md
